license.author: Pixel-boy / Sparklin Labs
license.note: Character sheet and portrait faceset used verbatim under CC0 1.0 from the pinned Ninja Adventure pack. The roster selection, atlas route and frame mapping are project code recorded separately.

notes: Assigned to the historic regional guides and the country ambassadors by position in the roster declared in src/civic-engine.js; the numeric sprite id is stored in the npc_mayors.sprite and npc_ambassadors.sprite columns.
The portrait faceset is vendored at assets/mayors/facesets/, the route the client loads; it is byte-identical to the pack layout copy at assets/mayors/characters/faceset/.
Sheets 4 and 8 from the same pack are excluded: they carry only two rows and cannot serve the four-direction walk animation.
The 20 sheets repeat across the 248 country ambassadors: several countries share one portrait. This is deliberate reuse of the sealed CC0 pack, not 248 unique portraits.
